title: Affine residue field scalar extension and transport
statement: Let W be a scheme, U an affine open, and z a point of U [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-residue-field]. Set A = Gamma(W,U), p = hU.isoSpec.hom(z), and k = kappa_W(z). Let e: k -> kappa(p) be the residue-field isomorphism U.ι.residueFieldMap(z), followed by the inverse of hU.isoSpec.hom.residueFieldMap(z), followed by Spec.residueFieldIso(A,p). Extension of A-modules to kappa(p) followed by restriction along e is naturally isomorphic to extension along the section evaluation A -> k. This is an isomorphism of functors on all A-modules, without derived-category, freeness, finiteness or flatness assumptions.

source.place: Tag 0098 (sheaves-lemma-stalk-pullback), open restriction germs; Mathlib residue-field naturality and scalar adjunctions

proof.text: Cancel Spec.residueFieldIso.inv and the chart residueFieldMap. Spec.algebraMap_residueFieldIso_inv and Gammaevaluation_naturality reduce the ring identity evaluation followed by e.hom equals algebraMap to compatibility of ambient germs with open restriction. Use residue_residueFieldMap, Opens.stalkIso_inv and Opens.germ_stalkIso_hom; Opens.topIso and presheaf.germ_res give exactly that compatibility.

Convert e to a ring equivalence er. Compose extendRestrictScalarsAdj for A -> kappa(p) with the restriction equivalence adjunction for er. The ring identity implies er.inverse composed with algebraMap equals evaluation. The natural restrictScalarsComp comparison identifies the right adjoint of this composite with restriction along evaluation. Conjugating this isomorphism of right adjoints gives the required isomorphism of left adjoints. It is natural for all module maps and therefore also for differentials.

from.place: Object-level affine residue calculation, before the homology step, in step 1 of the residue differential argument. Affine residue field scalar extension and transport.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_residue_scalar_transport (W : Scheme.{v}) (U : W.Opens)
    (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (z : U) :
    let e := asIso (U.ι.residueFieldMap z) ≪≫
      (asIso (hU.isoSpec.hom.residueFieldMap z)).symm ≪≫
        Spec.residueFieldIso Γ(W, U) (hU.isoSpec.hom z)
    Nonempty (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{v, v, v}
      (algebraMap Γ(W, U) (hU.isoSpec.hom z).asIdeal.ResidueField) ⋙
        ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{v, v, v} e.hom.hom ≅
      ModuleCat.extendScalars.{v, v, v} (W.evaluation U z z.property).hom)
